item.title: Funny Playing FPGB Mini Challenges Analogue Pocket Pricing
item.description: Chinese hardware specialist Funny Playing launches the $69 FPGB Mini, a ultra‑compact Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridge player that directly challenges the $239 Analogue Pocket’s multi‑system capabilities. It offers a minimalist design, lower price point, and targets retro enthusiasts who prioritize portability over broad cartridge support. The launch also raises questions about market segmentation, Chinese manufacturing influence, and the future of handheld retro gaming in 2026.
